name: Throes of Chaos
oracle_text:
Cascade (When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom in a random order.)
Retrace (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.)
blocked_sentences: Retrace (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.)

needs.what: the residual gate (authoring/verify.py _covered) must claim a bare 'Retrace (reminder)' keyword line when the card sets card-level `retrace: true`, as it already does for a bare 'Rebound' line, so a sorcery whose only text is keyword lines (Cascade + Retrace, no spell_effects) can pass
needs.why_existing_wont_do: card-level `retrace: true` loads and the engine supports it, but the line is only ever claimed wholesale by non-empty spell_effects (Decaying Time Loop, Embrace the Unknown) or by _GRAVEYARD_ADDITIONAL_LINE, which matches the unprefixed 'You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding...' sentence, not the 'Retrace (...)' keyword line; with spell_effects empty --collect rejects it: 'printed text not represented: Retrace'. Adding a filler spell effect would be inventing text
